Chapter 749: Chapter 32: How Did This Line Move On Its Own? (Please subscribe)_3

That’s why Lin Yuan did what he had just done, crossing the line to infuriate the Four Divine Kings among the six powerhouses.

As long as the other side became provoked and collectively crossed the line to confront Lin Yuan, just like the frail old man and the other four powerhouses teamed up to confront the Four Divine Kings earlier.

Lin Yuan would then have a reason to slay them and snatch their wonders.

“I said, those who cross the line shall be killed. Now that you’ve all crossed it, my killing you wouldn’t be excessive, would it?”

It’s just that now… Lin Yuan hadn’t anticipated that the Four Divine Kings along with the other five powerhouses would be so cowardly.

“Did the aura I released just now scare them?”

...

Lin Yuan reflected on himself, roughly understanding the reason.

“Forget it, I won’t pretend any longer.”

Lin Yuan sighed, no longer caring about appearance or reputation.

The next moment.

The ‘black line’ that originally encircled most of the mountain peak suddenly began to expand.

Almost in the blink of an eye, it had enclosed the Four Divine Kings, the frail old man, and the other five powerhouses within it.

“Hm?”

The Four Divine Kings had been planning to withdraw from the mountain peak, distancing themselves from Lin Yuan.

But then they discovered, to their surprise, the black line drawn by Lin Yuan started to rapidly expand, and before he could react, he found himself already within its confines.

“How can the line move?”

The Four Divine Kings were somewhat dazed.

The frail old man and the other five powerhouses in the distance hadn’t reacted either.

They were moving away from Lin Yuan. How had they ended up within the black line?

“You?”

The Four Divine Kings and the other powerhouses immediately realized something, turning to look at Lin Yuan who stood before the gates of heaven.

“Alright, since you’ve all crossed the line, don’t blame me for taking action.”

Lin Yuan turned slowly, his gaze calm, as he spoke unhurriedly.

“If you want to make a move, don’t bother looking for a reason.”

The Four Divine Kings’ eyes gradually filled with madness. With his quick thinking, he realized that Lin Yuan had never intended to let them go.

Buzz.

The Four Divine Kings’ four arms glowed, emitting an aura far surpassing that of when they had clashed with the frail old man and the other five powerhouses.

Whoosh.

Lin Yuan appeared silently in front of the Four Divine Kings, pressing down gently with his right hand.

There was no intense collision, nor any ripple of strength released, as if it was merely a light touch, but the Four Divine Kings’ arms began to twist and deform, their limbs crumbled to dust, and they were sent flying backward, crashing harshly at the edge of the mountain peak.

“Supreme weapon, indeed lives up to its reputation.”

Lin Yuan nodded slightly. If it hadn’t been for the sudden protective force erupting from the Four Divine Kings’ arms just now, the opponent would have been annihilated by his palm strike.

Even so, the current Four Divine Kings had essentially lost sixty percent of their combat power.

“Go.”

Seeing this, the frail old man and the other five powerhouses, who initially planned to see if they could join forces with the Four Divine Kings, saw the latter being severely injured by Lin Yuan and dared not linger any longer, fleeing in different directions.

“Think you can escape?”

Lin Yuan exhaled softly as a terrifying aura erupted from his body, the thick blood qi spreading in all directions, enveloping everything.

Where the blood qi covered, the air turned viscous. The frail old man and the other five powerhouses felt as though they were carrying a massive mountain, their movements slowed to a crawl.

In the Two-dimensional World, where the suppression degrades all extraordinary powers, the so-called fields and worlds simply cannot exist.

The Blood Qi Field Lin Yuan displayed wasn’t a field or world, but a natural force field generated by his blood and physical strength reaching a certain level.

Like in the Cosmic Starry Sky, the larger the celestial body, the greater its natural influence and range; this was purely physical law, and it applied here in this Two-dimensional World too.

“Aaah?!”

The frail old man suddenly turned around because Lin Yuan had already appeared behind him.

“I have defensive wonders; you can’t kill me.” The frail old man didn’t continue to flee but stopped to face Lin Yuan’s attack.

The Four Divine Kings, with their respective perfect weapons, had refined such treasures and thus, showed no interest in wonders of the Two-dimensional World.

With his strength, the Four Divine Kings never believed he would need such defensive wonders.

But the frail old man was different. He was wearing two defensive wonders and believed that, no matter how strong Lin Yuan was, it would be difficult for him to be killed.

However.

Lin Yuan struck out with his palm again.

Whoosh.

The terrifying force penetrated the frail old man’s two defensive wonders, leaving only one hundred-thousandth of the strength to land on him.

But even one hundred-thousandth of the strength was more than the frail old man could withstand. In an instant, his internal organs were shattered, and he lost all resistance.

Whew!

Lin Yuan appeared instantly behind the third powerhouse, delivering another palm strike.

The fourth, a palm strike.

The fifth, a palm strike.

…

“This…” The Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses who were watching the battle were shocked speechless at the one-sided slaughter.

If they had not seen it with their own eyes, they would never believe that legendary Level Eleven Perfect beings like the Four Divine Kings and the frail old man could be so easily slaughtered.

Other than a Supreme Being, who could achieve this?

…

At the deepest part of the Two-dimensional World.

This area could no longer be considered part of the Two-dimensional World but a more concealed space.

On a vast expanse of land, an old man barely half a meter tall lay leisurely in an armchair, his eyes squinted, relaxed.

In front of him was a huge ‘scroll’.

The ‘scroll’ was filled with mist, as if it contained a vast and real world.

The half-meter-tall old man, who was previously sleeping, was suddenly disturbed as if something had interrupted his slumber, opened his eyes, and glanced at the giant ‘scroll’ in front of him.

“In just over three hundred years, breaking through the limit of thirty worlds? Did I stumble upon a treasure this time?” The half-meter-tall old man’s eyes gleamed with surprise, as he began to observe intently.

“No, this talent is too monstrous. I need to watch longer…”

After considering, the half-meter-tall old man thought, “Let’s continue observing for another ten thousand years, to see to what heights you can eventually reach.”
